No. 2391/33 – FRIDAY, JULY 05, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 I hereby give notice, under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No 28 of 1964, that the government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose:
Description of the land to be acquired:

Allotments of 03 Lots in Total Extent of about 0.0642 Hectare, depicted in Cadastral Plan No. 420206, Zonal No. 07 and Sheet No. 01 dated 30.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Palle Gattuwana in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 717, Palle Gattuwana in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mallawapitiya in Kurunegala District in North - West Province.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Wali Kumbura; Description : Paddy field; Claimant: Original Claimant cannot be found. (Acquired under Section 38 (A) of Land Acquisition Act., To Finalise the land acquisition); Extent: 0.0024 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Divisional Secretary's Office of Mallwapitiya on the 12th August 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 7th August 2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. W.P.C.N. PATHIRANA, Divisional Secretary, Mallawapitiya. At Divisional Secretary's Office, Mallawapitiya, 11th June 2024.
